text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the Takarazuka Kinen, Meisho Doto comes into the prep room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She talks about her lack of confidence, her respect for Admire Vega, and her admiration of T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, she declares that she'll defeat Admire Vega and become T.M. Opera O's rival herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Admire Vega can't lose either. This is the spring Grand Prix, a race sure to make her sister proud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With each runner carrying their own hopes and dreams, the curtain rises over the Takarazuka Kinen.
